exposure: low implantation of the gestational sac
cohort: 68 women with a diagnosis of low implantation on first-trimester ultrasound
finding: Low implantation in the first trimester was found to significantly increase the risk of persistent placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in women with a history of cesarean delivery, with smallest myometrial thickness (SMT) being the most predictive parameter.
mod_finding: This study found that women with prior cesarean delivery and low implantation of the gestational sac in the first trimester have an increased risk of placenta accreta spectrum and persistent placenta previa.
